title: Shiyponda 48 yoshli odam nimani ixtiro qildi?

scenes.text: 48 yoshli yaponiyalik tadbirkor uyining hovlisidagi kichik shiyponda taxminan bir yil tajriba qildi.
Undan oldin u direktorlardan biri bo'lgan kredit tashkiloti bankrot bo'lgan, deyarli hamma narsasidan ayrilgan edi.
U qaynoq suv quyilsa bir necha daqiqada tayyor bo'ladigan lapsha yaratmoqchi edi.
Bu odam Momofuku Ando edi. 1958 yil avgustida u dunyodagi ilk tez tayyorlanadigan lapshani sotuvga chiqardi.
1971 yilda u stakandagi lapsha, Cup Noodles'ni ham chiqardi.

description:
Momofuku Ando direktor bo'lgan kredit tashkiloti bankrot bo'lgach, Ikeda shahridagi uyining hovlisida shiyponda tajriba qilgan. 1958 yil avgustida, 48 yoshida, Chicken Ramen nomli ilk tez tayyorlanadigan lapshani chiqargan. 1971 yilda Cup Noodles paydo bo'lgan.

Siz ham biror ishni noldan boshlaganmisiz? Izohda yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; Wikipedia and nippon.com could not be opened from this session). Nissin Foods founder page (nissin.com/en_jp/about/founder: Ando a director of a credit union that went bankrupt in 1957, lost his property except a house in Ikeda, Osaka); Nippon.com 'Shapers of Japanese History' (about a year of work in a back-garden shed); HISTORY.com and NPR (Chicken Ramen launched 25 Aug 1958, described as the world's first instant noodles); Wikipedia Momofuku Ando (born 5 March 1910, so 48 in 1958); Cup Noodles 1971 (Nissin, Smithsonian). Fixes: 'raislik qilgan' changed to 'direktorlardan biri' (Nissin's own wording); 'uyi qolgan' dropped because rented or owned is disputed; '1958 yilda ... bir yil tajriba' was ambiguous.
